title: UPI Transaction Failure and Auto-Reversal Policy
content: When money is debited from the sender's bank account during a UPI transaction but the beneficiary does not receive the funds, NPCI guidelines provide automatic reversal. Most failed UPI transactions auto-reverse within T+1 business day and at most within 3 to 5 working days. If the reversal is not credited after 3 working days, the customer should raise a transaction dispute inside the UPI app under Transaction History using the 12-digit UTR or RRN reference number, or contact customer support to log a reconciliation ticket.

title: UPI Daily Transfer Limits and Incorrect Beneficiary Policy
content: Standard peer-to-peer UPI transfers carry a daily limit of up to Rs 1,00,000 per 24 hours across up to 20 transactions, with a lower Rs 5,000 cap during the first 24 hours after resetting UPI MPIN or changing a SIM card. If funds were sent intentionally to an incorrect UPI ID, the bank cannot unilaterally reverse settled payments without beneficiary consent and recipient-bank recall mediation.
